svg.title: Inside the /opennms web application: listeners, filters, servlets
svg.desc: At start-up the listeners run once. Then every request runs through the filters in order, and one servlet answers. The ProxyFilter comes last: it hands paths that OSGi has claimed to Felix instead (Step 12).
svg.text: Inside the /opennms web application: listeners, filters, servlets
At start-up the listeners run once. Then every request runs through the filters in order, and one servlet answers.
The ProxyFilter comes last: it hands paths that OSGi has claimed to Felix instead (Step 12).
At start-up, once: the listeners, in web.xml order
For every request: the filters, in order
one Hibernate session for the whole request
user settings, refresh headers, table export
